system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: canonical raw sources → `~/.pilot/rules/`, `~/.pilot/skills/`, and `~/.pilot/agents/`. Each agent's adapter consumes these sources in its own format.
system_prompt_style.note: Rules/skills/AGENTS.md guidance layered onto host agent prompts.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: Semble, CodeGraph, RTK, language servers, browser automation, and MCP integrations support discovery, impact analysis, implementation, and runtime proof
env_context_strategy.note: Agent navigation plus injected persistent context/code intelligence.

context_compaction.evidence_quote: prior decisions, and session state survive long work and compaction
context_compaction.note: console/src/cli/handlers/summarize.ts summarization handler; host agent compaction.

observation_format.evidence_quote: browser automation, and device checks turn completion claims into evidence

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: using their built-in concepts (rules, hooks, skills, subagents, MCP) to improve your experience
tool_call_format.note: Tool calling is the host agent's (Claude Code/Codex) native mechanism.

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: **7 MCP servers** — library docs, persistent memory, web search, code search, page fetching, code intelligence

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: Plan against the real codebase, implement with TDD, review independently, and verify end to end
loop_primitives.note: Direct request (react) is the default path; /spec adds plan_execute, /build and /fix add test-repair rounds.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: Requirements, plans, buildouts, tasks, criteria, and verification evidence live in durable files under `docs/`.

multi_agent_topology.note: Sub-agents/independent reviewers reachable via workflows; base path is a single agent.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: using their built-in concepts (rules, hooks, skills, subagents, MCP)
delegation_mechanism.note: Independent review agents invoked as host-agent subagents.

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: the Console connects plan and diff review, annotations, progress, evidence, session recovery, shared project knowledge, and usage
human_in_loop.note: /spec requires plan approval before implementation; diff review at completion; workflow settings configurable in Console.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: Requirements, plans, buildouts, tasks, criteria, and verification evidence live in durable files under `docs/`.

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: **Persistent memory** — decisions and context survive across sessions in a local SQLite database
long_term_memory.note: Skills library installed to ~/.pilot/skills/; Chroma vector sync present (console/src/services/sync/ChromaSync.ts).

state_persistence.evidence_quote: Recover Claude Code and Codex sessions and search source-linked project knowledge.

self_verification.evidence_quote: linting, formatting, type checking, and test enforcement happen as hooks, not suggestions
self_verification.note: Independent judge in /build turns gaps into next round.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: Stop guards keep the workflow open until the obligations pass or are reported unresolved.

rollback.note: Git stash/branch/worktree controls in Console Changes view.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: hooks, stop guards, independent reviews, full test/build gates, and browser or device verification prevent “looks done” handoffs
termination_condition.note: Stop guards block premature model-declared completion; host agent supplies other limits.

cost_controls.evidence_quote: **Pilot Shell** handles model routing in one config file: Opus for `/spec` planning, Sonnet for everyday iteration, Haiku for trivial calls.
cost_controls.note: Console shows usage and costs; caching inferred from host agent prompt caching.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: Installs globally on macOS, Linux, and Windows (WSL2). After installation, run `claude` or `codex` directly.
execution_isolation.note: Dev Container and Claude Code /sandbox are optional hardening paths.

filesystem_access.evidence_quote: **Works with any existing project.** Pilot Shell integrates with **Claude Code** and **Codex CLI or ChatGPT desktop**
filesystem_access.note: Runs on the host with the user's own filesystem access.

network_policy.evidence_quote: See Anthropic's [development containers](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/devcontainer) and [sandboxing](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/sandboxing) docs for hardening patterns (egress allowlist, managed settings, persistent volumes).
network_policy.note: Egress allowlist only as an optional external hardening pattern.

permission_model.evidence_quote: **Quality hooks** — Claude Code auto-formats, lints, type-checks, and enforces TDD on edits; both agents enforce the checks required by an active workflow
permission_model.note: Hooks gate tool calls; a read-only bash filter also ships (console/src/shared/bash-readonly-filter.ts).

tracing.evidence_quote: local web dashboard at `localhost:41777` for sessions, memories, workflow artifacts, changes, usage, and configuration

replayability.evidence_quote: Recover Claude Code and Codex sessions and search source-linked project knowledge.

eval_hooks.evidence_quote: [`/benchmark` · `$benchmark`](https://pilot-shell.com/docs/workflows/benchmark) | Measure a rule or skill against falsifiable before/after evals

guardrails.note: Prompt-submit and pre-tool hooks plus stop guards can block.

target_domain.evidence_quote: Build production-grade software with spec-driven development, TDD, persistent memory, quality gates, code intelligence, human oversight, and end-to-end verification.
target_domain.note: web via browser automation / Chrome DevTools MCP.

open_source.note: Source public but a license key is required; see LICENSE.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: Pilot Shell supports **Claude Code** (primary — full feature coverage) and **Codex** through Codex CLI or the ChatGPT desktop app
model_agnostic.note: Limited to Anthropic and OpenAI host agents.
